title: Post by evolving.ai
description:
🚨 9 open-source projects doing the job of software people pay $$$$ for. 

Every tool here lives on GitHub, costs nothing to use, and is good enough to stand in for a paid product, from research notebooks to SEO suites to image generation. 

It is built for anyone who would rather self-host than subscribe. 

Tap any tool in the index to jump to it, grab the repo link, and check what it actually costs to run before you commit.

1. Open Notebook

An open source NotebookLM alternative. Add PDFs, videos, websites and notes, then chat with them, summarize them or turn them into podcasts.

Link: github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook

2. No AI Slop

A free skill that removes 20+ AI writing patterns and can scan text to show you where they appear.

Link: github.com/petergyang/no-ai-slop

3. I Have ADHD

A skill that makes coding agents answer directly, structure multi step work and remove unnecessary padding.

Link: github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd

4. OpenSEO

An MIT licensed Semrush and Ahrefs alternative with keyword research, rank tracking, backlinks, site audits and MCP support.

Link: github.com/every-app/open-seo

5. Book to Skill

Turns books into skills your coding agent can use, loading only the chapter relevant to your question.

Link: github.com/virgiliojr94/book-to-skill

6. Omni Route

Puts hundreds of AI providers behind one endpoint and automatically switches when you hit usage limits.

Link: github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute

7. AI Job Search

Turns Claude Code into a job search assistant for matching roles, tailoring CVs, cover letters and interview prep.

Link: github.com/MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search

8. Strix

AI agents that test your app for vulnerabilities and return working proof of concepts plus fix guidance.

Link: github.com/usestrix/strix

9. ComfyUI

Generate images and video locally with a visual node graph using models like Stable Diffusion, Flux and Wan.

Link: github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI

What are your thoughts on this? 🤔💬
